_doc: Macro trend indicators from independent evaluators. Pipeline may append new points.

indicators.name: Cyber time-horizon doubling time (UK AISI, 80% reliability)
indicators.note: Mythos Preview and GPT-5.5 (Apr–May 2026) landed above even the 4.7-month trend.

indicators.name: Open-weight lag behind US frontier (NIST CAISI)
indicators.note: GLM-5.3, the most cyber-capable open-weight model, trails the US frontier by ~4 months on CAISI's aggregate cyber benchmarks.
